releases.body:
## 2026.11.5-beta.2

### Highlights

- Large conversations remain browsable with paged history in both directions, visible history boundaries, and bounded archive reads. (#188450 #188483 #188557 #188372 #190690) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @xydt-tanshanshan.
- The macOS app preserves saved secrets and Gateway authentication when configuration saves fail or Tailscale exposure is turned off. (#187734 #187664; related #187600, #187597) Thanks @anmol0b.
- Ending Talk on Android no longer cancels work the Gateway has already accepted. (#188798; related #188134) Thanks @RomneyDa and @jeffjhunter.

### Changes

- Google: use the Interactions API for Gemini Flash models on the official endpoint while retaining custom endpoint overrides. (#189395) Thanks @obviyus.

### Fixes

- Security: reject malformed URI identifiers using fast-uri 4.2.3 while preserving valid relative references. (#187284) Thanks @RomneyDa and @shakkernerd.
- Security: reject oversized bounded collections early in the Discord SDK and its transitive Zod 3 parser without restoring the retired A2UI integration. (#187296 #187303) Thanks @RomneyDa and @shakkernerd.
- Message delivery: acknowledge retried committed input without starting duplicate turns, retain queued messages during inline edits, and keep Control UI plugin-reload replies from leaking into the last external chat. (#188527 #189869 #190982; related #189845, #190980) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @shakkernerd, and @Satoshi-Kusumoto.
- Chat recovery: preserve completed reasoning, refill chat snapshots, retain active-request provenance through compaction, and resume configured fallbacks after interrupted attempts. (#188203 #180214 #188672; related #188181) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @shakkernerd and @RomneyDa.
- Sessions: bound listing, imported-history, and accounting reads without blocking writers; omit misleading continuation metadata from centered history. (#189284 #190182 #188612) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @shakkernerd.
- PostgreSQL: keep session search on its text index across repeated searches, use a safe iMessage recovery cursor, and allow Boards widgets to publish. (#187909 #188979 #184919 #189564; related #187908, #188954, #184862) Thanks @etzelm, @obviyus, and @galiniliev.
- Files: preserve the identity of Unicode keys when reading and editing workspace paths. (#189868; related #189866) Thanks @Malpin07 and @obviyus.
- File transfer: avoid first-turn workspace-memory and skills import races when plugins load from TypeScript source. (#191838) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Agents: keep subagent turns and model fallback aligned with changed session capabilities, and surface child approval requests to parents using custom session stores. (#179312 #183501 #189827; related #179290, #189823) Thanks @chelsealong, @obviyus, @Marvinthebored, @RomneyDa, and @ekinnee.
- Tool outcomes: retain timeout results so interrupted tools are not mistaken for confirmed failures without side effects. (#180247) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Matrix: start new thread sessions without copying the room transcript; report readiness only after startup, let stopped CLI clients exit, and report late verification failures rather than crashing. (#177272 #192385; related #176224) Thanks @Linux2010, @obviyus, @seriouslysean, and @RomneyDa.
- Google: honor configured topP and restore tool calls whose parameter names are Python keywords. (#190695 #191561; related #190468) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @Yigtwxx, @obviyus, @yetval, and @HighervGround.
- Anthropic: keep setup-token credentials separate from API-key profiles, set the API workspace at login, and allow reasoning-only retries. (#187875 #186976 #184434; related #187868, #187018, #182178) Thanks @RomneyDa, @sasan1200, @sukhdeepjohar, and @goslingmanagment.
- Models: keep healthy providers available when another provider lacks credentials or its catalog hook fails, and scope discovery warnings to the affected provider. (#189014 #189059 #188541) Thanks @obviyus.
- Codex: preserve conversation guidance; resolve native follow-ups by task name, wait for previous thread owners to unload, and preserve one-shot cleanup. (#189005 #191830; related #188929) Thanks @lastguru-net, @beru-ant-king, @obviyus, and @RomneyDa.
- macOS connections: resolve typed authentication references, prefer configured credentials over stale app environment values, and replace stale Gateway services safely after in-place updates. (#128175 #191468 #187000; related #128171) Thanks @TheAngryPit, @CassieMei, @obviyus, @RomneyDa, and @anmol0b.
- macOS tools and UI: show load failures instead of blank or stale browser pages, avoid duplicate voice sends and false sent feedback, preserve no-timeout execution results, and use the correct Peekaboo observation references. (#185432 #186271 #190729 #172116) Thanks @etzelm, @RomneyDa, @anmol0b, @holgergruenhagen, and @LiuwqGit.
- Settings: support remote Control UI base paths and open GitHub reconnection from the active session. (#185141 #180200; related #164596) Thanks @RomneyDa, @anmol0b, and @goldmar.
- Updates: recover cleanly from failed upgrades out of 2026.10.7–2026.10.9, preserve recovery errors and asynchronous triage callbacks, avoid first-launch Gateway failures, and read candidate state without copying the shared database. (#189713 #191495 #191436 #187921 #189023) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @PollyBot13.
- Plugins: run continuing native commands once, respect disabled mixed-case plugin IDs, restore CLI message sends under agent tool policies, and avoid recopying managed binaries on startup. (#189369 #188846 #188058 #187865; related #189367, #188845) Thanks @nxmxbbd, @obviyus, @masatohoshino, @Marvinthebored, and @jasonftl.
- Startup and shutdown: honor pending-channel webhook decisions, keep lease renewal independent of parent admission, and avoid reopening agent databases during shutdown. (#169778 #188391 #188976) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @htjworld and @vincentkoc.
- Scheduling and startup diagnostics: run jobs added before scheduler startup without an extra deferral and flush startup evidence before declaring readiness. (#192379 #192383) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Storage: preserve cold-database admission and retry contended lease cleanup using the renewed lease expiry. (#192378) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Configuration: ignore empty default plugin entries rather than widening an explicitly restricted plugin allowlist. (#192380) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Process startup: preserve cleanup grace and report the original startup error ahead of cleanup failures while sharing inherited process lineage across module copies. (#192386) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Worktrees: settle completed disk usage accounting even when a postcheck refuses further work. (#188727) Authored by @steipete.

- macOS service runtime ownership: prepare and retain the stable executable across install, resume, migration, and service restoration without replacing a newer runtime during failed settlement. Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Release recovery: retain publication retry diagnostics and preserve the reconciled release repairs. (#189130 #191633) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Release notes: retain original contribution provenance for work first merged on a release branch. (#193613) Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.11.5-beta.1..d407001e75b7f7b94c30bbe3707aaf0bab9559dc history: 95 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 95 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

releases.body:
## 2026.11.3

### Highlights

- **Private task results:** Keep private subagent completions out of streamed chat replies. (#188490) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev.
- **Reliable child-task handoffs:** Allow a parent to hand off to replacement work after cancelling a child, without leaving the cancelled child's completion receipt blocking the handoff. (#178893; related #178565) Thanks @brianmcguire and @letsc4.
- **Visible tool failures:** Report unanswered tool failures instead of silently ending a user-addressed turn as a success. (#182458; related #99645) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @rdleclerc.
- **Bounded authentication:** Stop stalled provider authentication at the run deadline and propagate cancellation through authentication work. (#189144) Thanks @amittell.
- **Sandboxed image access:** Keep required-sandbox image previews inside allowed folders, even in Full Access mode, while preserving explicit administrator image allowances. (#176203) Thanks @shakkernerd.
- **Verified workspace connections:** Preserve saved node certificate pins when an empty fingerprint is supplied, and verify workspace-transfer certificates before sending credentials or data. (#125646, #190002) Thanks @wanyongstar and @avelev99.
- **Faster, responsive Gateway:** Reduce startup module-file loading overhead and avoid stalls when abort-command detection encounters long punctuation runs. (#192217, #184433) Thanks @karkarl, @RomneyDa, @LeizhenZhang, and @obviyus.

### Changes

No new configuration options or features.

### Fixes

- **Credential isolation:** Keep reused and cached plugin results scoped to their connection credentials, and keep other plugins' transport hooks on the provider's origin. (#178444, #177974, #189423) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @obviyus.
- **Search and memory credentials:** Keep Firecrawl search and scrape keys with their scoped endpoints and embedding credentials with their destination. (#190706, #184966) Thanks @zhangguiping-xydt and @eleqtrizit.
- **Credential redaction:** Redact inline environment credentials from configuration reads and reflected search credentials from Exa errors. (#190618, #178745) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @yetval.
- **Child-process environments:** Prevent managed Signal daemons and bundled language servers from inheriting unrelated Gateway secrets. (#179198, #179415) Thanks @VACInc.
- **Authentication errors:** Surface credential-read failures rather than treating them as missing credentials, and reject explicitly selected auth profiles belonging to incompatible providers. (#173970, #181597) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- **Channel safety:** Keep incoming Twitch IRC content out of parser error logs and require explicit request IDs when multiple Tlon approvals are pending. (#174552, #186243) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @mmaps.
- **Scheduled jobs:** Handle queued cron storage failures without exiting the Gateway, and clear one-shot cleanup when a job becomes recurring. (#175678, #168985) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @yxshee, @wangmiao0668000666, and @obviyus.
- **Updates:** Let profile-backed updates recognize their own maintenance lock and preserve cancellation when ledger writes are deferred. (#177792, #187998) Thanks @GrahamMcBain and @vincentkoc.
- **Update recovery:** Recover safely when the initial package-presence check times out, requiring a fresh valid directory identity before replacement and retaining rollback to the original package. (#181906) Authored by @steipete.
- **Anthropic usage caps:** Recognize exhausted plural usage-limit errors without spending the transient rate-limit retry budget. (#176186; related #176179) Thanks @sunlit-deng and @blue-dot-1.
- **Terminal sessions:** Forward /reset soft to the Gateway instead of hard-resetting the session. (#172431) Thanks @yetval and @obviyus.
- **Git recovery:** Preserve uncertain command failures during Git repair rather than treating an unconfirmed operation as successful. (#176006) Authored by @steipete.
- **Memory provider selection:** Accept mixed-case none and auto provider values. (#186310) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @sagealice2002-dotcom.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.11.2..abf11ef015b9d4cdf5b2e6e2a6a84b87c7b8c920 history: 34 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 34 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

releases.name: openclaw 2026.9.37
releases.body:
This is a gateway-only `extended-stable` release, published from a retired maintenance line by explicit maintainer decision. This release is OpenClaw from the end of September 2026, plus critical security updates, reliability and performance fixes, and features like new model support. The latest version of OpenClaw at the time of this release is [2026.11.2](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/releases#release-v2026.11.2)

## 2026.9.37

### Highlights

- **Private inspection stays private:** paired-node photos and screenshots are no longer automatically attached to replies, and explicit media-read denials are honored when preparing reply attachments. (#174814, #184964) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
- **Responsive replies and pages:** long zero-width Telegram table cells and malformed plugin SVG transforms no longer stall the Gateway or browser page. (#183217, #182674) Thanks @LeizhenZhang, @obviyus, and @SebTardif Authored by @steipete. Thanks @LeizhenZhang, @obviyus, and @SebTardif.
- **Linked accounts survive resets:** sessions keep their person-linked model account through `/new`, `/reset`, and idle or daily rollover. Fixes #179432. (#179433) Thanks @masatohoshino Authored by @steipete. Thanks @masatohoshino.
- **Safer update recovery:** interrupted snapshot writes preserve the previous rollback point, and profile-backed updates and Doctor maintenance no longer trip over their own maintenance ownership. (#189946, #177792, #187104) Thanks @kaguranananana, @GrahamMcBain, and @RomneyDa Authored by @steipete. Thanks @kaguranananana, @GrahamMcBain, and @RomneyDa.
- **Connections recover cleanly:** channel accounts can recover after a manual stop times out, and ClickClack reconnects after silent network drops. Fixes #184852. (#177444, #184853) Thanks @masatohoshino, @YangManBOBO, and @obviyus.
- **Windows state access works across path aliases:** equivalent Windows paths preserve the same state ownership instead of falsely reporting offline maintenance. Fixes #176163. (#176174) Thanks @tjarrau-dev Authored by @steipete. Thanks @tjarrau-dev.

### Changes

- **Faster plugin admission:** reuse native-reference validation within the same admission capture instead of repeatedly walking companion directories, while revalidating replacement captures and recovery copies. Fixes #162047. (#162254) Thanks @WG-Mojo Authored by @steipete. Thanks @WG-Mojo.

### Fixes

- **Private diagnostics:** omit suppressed reply text and background command contents from verbose diagnostics while retaining status metadata. Thanks @steipete.
- **Media boundaries:** keep paired-node inspection photos and screenshots private by default, and honor explicit read denials for reply attachments without blocking authorized managed outputs. (#174814, #184964) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
- **Restrictive group policies:** Doctor preserves explicitly empty group allowlists, inherited settings, and disabled group policies instead of populating fallback senders. Fixes #173826. (#174787) Thanks @lockhartheavyindustries Authored by @steipete. Thanks @lockhartheavyindustries.
- **Discovery output:** escape terminal control characters in untrusted Gateway discovery fields. (#183355) Thanks @Alix-007.
- **State and write outcomes:** recognize committed SQLite writes whose worker result cannot be serialized, avoiding unsafe replay, and preserve Windows ownership across equivalent path spellings. Fixes #176163. (#177321, #176174) Thanks @tjarrau-dev Authored by @steipete. Thanks @tjarrau-dev.
- **Session accounts:** retain linked model-account selections and their provenance through explicit resets and automatic rollover. Fixes #179432. (#179433) Thanks @masatohoshino Authored by @steipete. Thanks @masatohoshino.
- **Channel recovery:** recover channel accounts after timed-out manual stops and restore ClickClack message reception after silent network drops. Fixes #184852. (#177444, #184853) Thanks @masatohoshino, @YangManBOBO, and @obviyus.
- **Local tool connections:** replace unexpectedly closed MCP loopback listeners and retain their cleanup work for shutdown rather than leaving later tool calls permanently disconnected. Fixes #139340. (#183352) Thanks @SC-10749 and @eli-pavlov Authored by @steipete. Thanks @eli-pavlov and @SC-10749.
- **Telegram and Control UI:** bound the processing of long zero-width table cells and malformed SVG transform strings without changing valid table or icon rendering. (#183217, #182674) Thanks @LeizhenZhang, @obviyus, and @SebTardif Authored by @steipete. Thanks @LeizhenZhang, @obviyus, and @SebTardif.
- **Command results and temporary files:** preserve a completed command's exit result when detached-descendant cleanup is uncertain, retain a visible cleanup warning, and remove temporary MCP configuration directories when writing fails. Fixes #179555. (#185636, #179603) Thanks @xiaopan-xydt and @Yolo521-bot Authored by @steipete. Thanks @Yolo521-bot and @xiaopan-xydt.
- **Gateway credentials:** keep local password SecretRefs active when a separate remote token is configured, and retain a saved node TLS pin when the fingerprint option is empty or whitespace-only. (#128175, #125646) Thanks @TheAngryPit, @CassieMei, @obviyus, @RomneyDa, and @wanyongstar.
- **Update and restart reliability:** preserve rollback snapshots after interrupted writes, release completed maintenance before reopening requester policy, confirm predecessor stop receipts during Doctor maintenance, and prepare configuration restarts outside the restart-signal fence. releases.body:
## 2026.11.1

### Highlights

- Safer Mac settings: failed config saves no longer overwrite secrets, and turning off Tailscale exposure keeps Gateway authentication intact. (#187734, #187664) Fixes #187600, #187597 Thanks @anmol0b.
- More reliable channel replies: Telegram, Discord, and webhook conversations keep reaching the agent after request handlers or earlier turns finish. (#179200, #179385, #179704, #189457) Fixes #178554 Thanks @steipete, @LiuwqGit, @jalehman, and @vincentkoc.
- Conversations survive more interruptions: oversized turns retain useful history, and stopping the first Claude CLI turn no longer starts the next message from scratch. (#191146, #181966, #186380) Fixes #191133, #181945 Thanks @Yun-0000, @obviyus, @mirasrael, and @holgergruenhagen.
- Update recovery gets unstuck after crashed or canceled updaters, restores the Windows Gateway after failed verification, and avoids repeated full-database copying during large-state checks. (#177932, #186787, #189647, #182632, #187921) Fixes #177684, #184893, #189620 Thanks @duyufansh2008, @RomneyDa, @fuller-stack-dev, @TheAngryPit, @sukhdeepjohar, @steipete, @syxscott, and @stephen3303.
- Subagents keep their follow-ups through model and session changes, while parent sessions receive child approvals even with a custom session store. (#186238, #183501, #189827) Fixes #179289, #189823 Thanks @steipete, @Marvinthebored, @RomneyDa, and @ekinnee.
- Android End Talk with a compatible Gateway stops listening without canceling accepted agent work, so its answer can still arrive in chat; explicit cancellation remains available. (#172276, #188798) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Provider recovery respects provider-specified rate-limit timing, and Gemini Flash text models use Interactions by default on the official API-key endpoint while custom proxies retain their existing default. (#180280, #189395) Thanks Ayaan Zaidi, @evomach, @sukhdeepjohar, @RomneyDa.

### Changes

- Claude CLI: saved subscription accounts can make configured models available without a separate native login, and operators can opt into native Agent and Workflow orchestration through `plugins.entries.anthropic.config.managedNativeTools`; the default remains off and restricted runs keep their existing tool limits. (#179203, #183765) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Anthropic: API-key setup can record an optional Anthropic workspace ID; existing workspace headers are preserved, and workspace-scoped keys need no extra setting. (#186976) Thanks Ayaan Zaidi, @evomach, @sukhdeepjohar, @RomneyDa.
- Google: Interactions requests honor managed proxy and TLS settings, rotate eligible API keys before streaming after a rate limit, preserve native video input, and forward nucleus sampling consistently; choose `google-generative-ai` when explicit Gemini cache handles are required. (#189395, #190695) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Bedrock Mantle: discovered numbered OpenAI GPT models select the Responses route automatically, while GPT-OSS keeps Chat Completions and Claude keeps Anthropic Messages. Thanks @MertBasar0, @anmol0b, @shakkernerd, @kybrcore, @sukhdeepjohar, @potoior, @RomneyDa.
- Control UI: the model picker shows the configured active context budget rather than only the model maximum, and short session links retain their intended navigation target. (#180870, #183148) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Google Chat: remote HTTP(S) attachments are delivered as visible links alongside captions; local files and native uploads remain unsupported with service-account authentication. Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Update diagnostics: detailed readiness separates a ready core from channel outages, allowing repaired updaters to finish with named channel warnings without hiding HTTP 503 or weakening normal service-start checks. Thanks @duyufansh2008, @RomneyDa.

### Fixes

- Network and tool safety: ClickClack and ClawHub reject redirects into unrelated private services, Discord CDN downloads no longer inherit browser private-network access, and FIFO native-hook credentials are rejected without hanging the agent. (#190944, #190939, #191458, #191423) Thanks @pgondhi987, @SebTardif, and @Leon-SK668.
- Doctor consent and access policy: noninteractive checks no longer download plugins without repair consent, and explicitly empty group allowlists remain empty instead of being repopulated. (#191523, #174787) Fixes #191420, #173826 Thanks @brandonulrich, @steipete, and @lockhartheavyindustries.
- Recovery data: malformed UTF-8 legacy imports are rejected instead of replacing original content; failed skill restore rollbacks preserve the original copy, and cleanup refuses destructive work when workspace inspection fails. (#180861, #173954, #174195, #176362) Fixes #180782, #180795 Thanks @RomneyDa, @duyufansh2008, @steipete, and @wangmiao0668000666.
- Log redaction: malformed custom entries no longer disable valid rules or built-in secret protection; invalid policy is reported while safe redaction remains active. (#173471) Thanks @skyzhao1223 and @RomneyDa.
- Secret egress: reject chains relying on the distrusted emSign ECC G3 root in the managed proxy and exported subprocess CA bundle; restart the Gateway after updating, and update clients with independent trust stores separately. (#179249) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- macOS connectivity: configured credentials take precedence over stale app environment, typed environment secret references resolve correctly, and remote Settings respects the Control UI base path. (#191468, #185141, #128175) Fixes #164596 Thanks @RomneyDa, @anmol0b, and @goldmar.
- Mac tools and messaging: iMessage remains usable after app updates without re-granting Automation, Peekaboo window inspection accepts valid snapshot references, and node exec preserves results for commands configured without a timeout. (#186107, #172116, #190729) Fixes #178719 Thanks @aniketkrs, @RomneyDa, @anmol0b, @SharkeyDev, @holgergruenhagen, @LiuwqGit, and @etzelm.
- Mac voice and embedded pages: avoid duplicate voice sends and false sent feedback, and show a recoverable load error instead of a blank or stale Mac tab. (#186271, #185432) Thanks @anmol0b, @etzelm, and @RomneyDa.
- Native voice and capture: iOS and macOS Talk tolerate slow audio acknowledgments within bounded buffering, long meeting replies are not cut off merely because generation outruns playback, and oversized Mac recordings fail with size guidance instead of dropping the node connection. Thanks @MertBasar0, @anmol0b, @shakkernerd, @kybrcore, @sukhdeepjohar, @potoior, and @RomneyDa.
- Android and desktop compatibility: Android Chat waits for the role-allowed agent list after switching Gateways, and independently updated Mac nodes can return optional cursor coordinates without a computer-use contract error. Thanks @MertBasar0, @anmol0b, @shakkernerd, @kybrcore, @sukhdeepjohar, @potoior, @RomneyDa.
- Channel recovery: Slack detects dead relay connections without treating ordinary silence as failure, Tlon reconnects stalled streams so unacknowledged events can replay, and managed Tailscale exposure recovers after a daemon restart while local authenticated access stays available. Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Channel delivery: Feishu keeps text from before and after tool calls in the same streaming card; Synology confirms delivery only from recipient-matched message IDs; Twitch targets and Zalo unsupported-event text follow their channel handling rather than silently losing usable content. Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Channel credentials and notices: implicit Slack default accounts retain complete top-level credentials alongside named accounts, channel secret consumers respect account activation, and Nostr reports failed pairing notifications without undoing approval. Thanks @RomneyDa.
- iMessage storage: recovery cursor keys no longer contain a PostgreSQL-incompatible NUL separator, allowing the channel to start with PostgreSQL-backed state. (#184919) Fixes #184862 Thanks @duyufansh2008, @RomneyDa, and @etzelm.
- Session and agent authority: deleting one agent no longer breaks other agents' tool authority, and local session-capability changes stop inappropriate provider fallback instead of trying every model. (#174918, #179312) Fixes #179290 Thanks @steipete, @chelsealong, @obviyus, and @Marvinthebored.
- Prompt caching: session tool definitions stay stable across turns, including completions, heartbeats, and non-owner requests, avoiding unnecessary prompt-cache misses. (#175309, #176167) Thanks @obviyus.
- Conversation recovery: compaction retains the active human request across repeated summaries; queue overflow summaries retain each visible sender and conversation context; exec completion guidance survives overflow. (#180214, #187833, #190698, #182188, #184216) Thanks @RomneyDa and @aniketkrs.
- Codex continuity: conversation-wide restrictions retain compatible native threads, temporary restrictions preserve the ordinary conversation binding, and a missing thread with recorded history reports an error instead of silently starting over. Thanks @skyzhao1223 and @RomneyDa.
- Codex replies: transient retries can summarize the original request and completed tools without rerunning them; terminal handoffs allow already-submitted steering a bounded chance to confirm consumption and do not automatically replay uncertain input. (#183077, #184062, #181839, #167390) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Shared credentials and model availability: concurrent MCP callers can reuse a fresh OAuth token without unnecessary exclusive locking, rate-limit cooldowns follow provider timing instead of accumulating hours of local backoff, and fresh model publications replace superseded refresh results. (#179997, #180280, #179144) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Claude CLI and scheduled work: canceled cron runs stop reply hooks, interrupted long-running jobs no longer prevent scheduler startup, oversized or invalid CLI streams cancel their subprocess promptly, and managed completions retain the policy-filtered tool catalog. (#181245, #191422, #159931, #172026) Thanks @steipete and @fuller-stack-dev.
- Session history and memory: long transcript decoding releases database read snapshots promptly, bounded history pages keep their requested anchors and adjacent messages, and memory indexing waits for archived transcript materialization. (#164442, #172970, #177937, #182091, #190182, #189284, #188450, #188483, #190690) Fixes #171467 Thanks @RomneyDa, and @etzelm.
- Subagent and restart recovery: live descendants keep their expired parents available for communication, accepted yields settle sibling tool results before handoff, and stale interrupted input no longer blocks a new human message indefinitely. (#179057, #184021, #180853, #181871, #178888, #184041, #184069, #172959) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Agent handoffs: waiting session sends recover the stored long reply instead of returning only a short lifecycle preview, and ACP-created sessions retain the requested working directory for later prompts. (#178271, #176852) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Control UI recovery: silently dead Gateway connections reconnect without replaying uncertain sends, consumed slash-steering messages leave the queue, and routine restart notices stay concise. (#179101, #178642, #180024, #172843) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- GitHub workflows: active sessions can open the reconnect flow, failed follow-up pushes retain the existing PR, and readers no longer hang while discarding response bodies. (#180200, #187835, #191721) Fixes #187832 Thanks @RomneyDa, @anmol0b, @obviyus, and @nocodet888-arch.
- Plugin lifecycle: startup avoids recopying managed binaries, repairs owned stale host links after installation-root changes, and keeps plugin background readers alive for admitted callbacks and cleanup; internal plugin reload resumes stay in the current session rather than using an old external recipient. (#187865, #181140, #182207, #179031, #181270, #179549, #190982) Thanks @Satoshi-Kusumoto, @RomneyDa, @jasonftl, and @obviyus.
- Gateway startup and shutdown: retry transient database locks during stale-claim cleanup and sidecar startup, and exit after clean shutdown instead of waiting for systemd to kill a process with a leaked handle. (#187724, #186920, #191251) Fixes #187723, #186875, #191119 Thanks @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @steipete, @yousan, @bianyuxia-commits, and @davesanvil.
- Update startup and migration: recover with retained worker indexes, avoid crashes in automatic migration recovery from 2026.10.7–2026.10.9, preserve recovery errors, and reject Git targets that require an unavailable newer Node before staging. (#189023, #189713, #191495, #181715) Thanks @RomneyDa and @steipete.
- Update repair: release abandoned cancellation custody and resolve pending package steps without repair loops; restore a suspended Windows Gateway task after failed verification while retaining the original failure details. (#177932, #186787, #189647) Fixes #177684, #184893, #189620 Thanks @RomneyDa, @fuller-stack-dev, @TheAngryPit, @sukhdeepjohar, @steipete, @syxscott, and @stephen3303.
- Update captures and service handoff: ignore Finder metadata when listing recovery captures, recover CLI Node runtimes when launched from `/`, and classify an unavailable automatic-update service handoff as skipped rather than an unrecorded failure. (#186663, #178112, #188405) Fixes #186650, #177739, #188302 Thanks @duyufansh2008, @RomneyDa, @steipete, @woshicby, @downingkeys, and @ARSA31.
- Doctor migrations: bound long Matrix archive filenames, preserve config promotion when only migration guidance changes, run explicitly requested headless repairs, return failure rather than success when required work was skipped, and retain invalid heartbeat quiet hours with actionable validation. (#187443, #190665, #187192, #186305) Fixes #187390, #190658, #187122 Thanks @RomneyDa, @skyzhao1223, @steipete, @dakoller, @saariuslystoned, and @JordanNewell.
- Configuration and store recovery: explain how to recover when an older binary meets newer config; relative session stores resolve against the active state directory, and Doctor merges legacy misplaced stores with backups while preserving conflicting conversations and refusing unsafe retirement. (#187639, #182444, #181554, #180414, #179089) Fixes #152791 Thanks @RomneyDa, @duyufansh2008, @steipete, and @kip-claw.
- Service and backup reliability: repaired updaters distinguish durable database changes from read-only WAL bookkeeping, wait for the serving Mac child to release state, preserve valid replacement config without metadata, and keep unrelated service overrides intact during supported Node repairs. Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Diagnostics and provider tools: timeout messages distinguish an unknown tool outcome from a safe retry, Anthropic PDF requests use the selected account's proper authentication, and Gemini/Vertex streams stop at terminal markers instead of consuming later frames. (#180247, #182429, #184434, #178420, #117397) Thanks Ayaan Zaidi, @evomach, @sukhdeepjohar, @RomneyDa, @MertBasar0, @anmol0b, @shakkernerd, @kybrcore, @potoior.

releases.name: openclaw 2026.11.5-beta.1
releases.body:
## 2026.11.5-beta.1

### Highlights

- **Knowledge Scribes:** add first-class knowledge capture and reusable scribe workflows across agents, sessions, and the Control UI. (#185583, #185637, #185974, #186270, #186455, #187659) Thanks @jalehman.
- **PostgreSQL data plane:** add PostgreSQL-backed state, migration tooling, and compatibility coverage for existing deployments. (#173968, #174080, #174085, #174183, #174242, #174374, #174387, #174399, #174623) Authored by @steipete.
- **Control UI:** overhaul mobile and desktop navigation, layouts, and interaction details. (#176356, #176466, #176505, #176540, #176557, #176653) Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski.
- **Pull requests from chat:** add end-to-end PR preparation, publication, review, and status workflows directly from conversations. (#176105, #176139, #178055, #178233, #178281, #178756) Thanks @shakkernerd.
- **Cross-device and cloud execution:** expand attached-device, cloud-placement, and cyber-access workflows, including safer capability handoffs. (#185230, #185477, #186560, #187408; related #186553) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @VACInc, @joshavant, @galiniliev, and @shakkernerd.
- **Decision and media models:** add specialized decision routing and media-capable model support, including ClawRouter integrations. (#177369, #178860, #178876, #178886, #178920, #179362; related #179360) Thanks @vincentkoc and @fuller-stack-dev.
- **Plugin experience:** improve plugin discovery, installation, authoring, and runtime integration. (#177869, #182419, #185315, #185544) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @jalehman.
- **Backup and upgrade safety:** harden backup, recovery, and upgrade paths with clearer state preservation and rollback behavior. (#186953, #187564, #187688, #187737; fixes #187519, #187678, #187657) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @art22s, @RomneyDa, @McgAtom, and @Yachiyo1680.

### Changes

- **Automations:** add persistent streams and richer execution context for durable scheduled work. (#177941, #177942, #179011, #179062, #179669, #182561) Thanks @joshavant, @eleqtrizit, and @jalehman.
- **Sharing and guests:** expand session sharing, guest access, and visitor lifecycle controls. (#181680, #182218, #182337, #182352) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @shakkernerd and @jalehman.
- **Learning and skills:** improve learned-skill capture, reuse, and guided authoring. (#181747, #181879, #186861) Thanks @obviyus and @jalehman.
- **Providers:** add and refine provider integrations, authentication, and model discovery. (#175509, #175729, #180788, #182248; related #175543) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @midhunvnadh, @obviyus, @lavicosa, and @hannesrudolph.
- **Native media:** expand native image, audio, and video handling across supported surfaces. (#174051, #174152, #178521; related #174048) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @dankarization, and @lordratner.
- **Session composition:** improve multi-session composition, routing, and coordinated execution. (#178842, #179609, #182742) Thanks @jalehman and @vyctorbrzezowski.
- **Credential compatibility:** improve credential migration and compatibility across legacy and current configuration formats. (#174294, #174599) Authored by @steipete.
- **Doctor compatibility:** broaden doctor checks and automated repair guidance for migrated installations. (#179387, #182328) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @jalehman.
- **Memory maintenance:** add safer memory cleanup and maintenance flows. (#182530; fixes #157280) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @islandpreneur007.
- **Model routing:** improve provider-aware model selection and routing behavior. (#180509, #183637) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @VACInc and @tommyjoseph.

### Fixes

- **Gateway startup:** fix startup recovery, dependency ordering, and service-state handling across upgrades. (#186920, #187724, #187819, #187870; fixes #186875, #187723) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @yousan, @bianyuxia-commits, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @RomneyDa, @jalehman, @fuller-stack-dev, and @vincentkoc.
- **Codex:** fix session lifecycle, result delivery, and tool-state edge cases in Codex-backed workflows. (#187337, #187348, #187375, #187873; fixes #187023, #187863) Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen, @wtfichigo, @obviyus, and @shakkernerd.
- **Reply correctness:** fix reply threading, quoting, deduplication, and destination selection across channel surfaces. (#187361, #187416, #187433, #187434, #187833; fixes #137197, #42106) Thanks @Marvinthebored, @Peetiegonzalez, @obviyus, @wyf027, @felixboenkost-droid, @ericcaiwx-star, @wbxl2000, @goslingmanagment, and @dmsrg399.
- **Channels and Talk:** fix admission, audio, delivery, and reconnect behavior across supported messaging and Talk integrations. (#186757, #187199, #187327, #187497, #187667, #187864, #187881; fixes #186756, #127534, #187665, #185664) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @wangmiao0668000666, @yousan, @xialonglee, @HermanZeng, @brianmcguire, and @ultrakorne.
- **Outbound media:** fix media attachment handling and preservation on outbound sends. (#187561; fixes #187359) Thanks @yousan, @obviyus, and @fonchaves.
- **Control UI accessibility:** fix keyboard, focus, labeling, and responsive interaction regressions. (#180896, #187219, #187263, #187521; fixes #187201) Thanks @goutamadwant, @LiuwqGit, @obviyus, @vincentkoc, and @Alix-007.
- **Control UI attachments:** prevent aborted `data:` URL attachment previews from triggering a native fetch crash. (#191451) Thanks @tideclaw-bot, @wangjx-xydt, and @RomneyDa.
- **Memory:** fix indexing, retrieval, migration, and cleanup edge cases. (#186829, #187429, #187621, #187797; fixes #187788) Thanks @SunnyShu0925, @obviyus, @Baumus, @Leon-SK668, and @fredtanxo.
- **Providers:** fix provider authentication, discovery, and request compatibility issues, including restoring Claude CLI model discovery when no Anthropic model is pinned. (#181527, #187365, #187523, #191148; fixes #151015, #143214) Thanks @KrasimirKralev, @obviyus, @yousan, @masatohoshino, @wyf027, @HighervGround, @etzelm, and @Takhoffman.
- **Automations:** fix scheduler execution and persisted-run recovery edge cases. (#187195, #187530; fixes #187334) Thanks @obviyus, @yousan, and @etzelm.
- **Doctor:** prevent hosted Doctor runs from stalling live sessions by bounding worker lifetime and cancellation. (#191125) Authored by @steipete.

### Complete contribution record

The full contribution record is available in the tag-pinned [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5-beta.1/CHANGELOG/records/2026.11.5-beta.1.md#complete-contribution-record).

releases.body:
## 2026.10.10-beta.5

### Highlights

- Node compatibility: installs and updates work again on Node `>=24.16.0 <25 || >=26.1.0`; Node 24.22.1 or 26.12.1 is now a security recommendation instead of a hard requirement, and Node 26 workers no longer abort when stdin is a file. (#186589, #187516) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Gateway streaming: replies that contain tool-call-like XML, look like tool calls, or end long HTML at a partial tag no longer stall the Gateway. (#181397, #183252, #180765; related #175156, #180720) Thanks @RomneyDa, @JasonBuildAI, and @LeizhenZhang.
- Updates and rollback: a failed npm rollback no longer strands the installed package, an immediate Git rollback keeps operator edits, and an update whose executor dies recovers its offline state. (#185160, #185201, #181695; related #184889, #184887, #181649) Thanks @LiuwqGit, @RomneyDa, @syxscott, @wr-web, and @PonySlayer28.
- Cron: missed slots with a stale stored next run time are no longer dropped, and startup catch-up runs are admitted after a restart. (#179928; related #179927) Thanks @andrewbowlds, @RomneyDa, and @shakkernerd.

### Changes

### Fixes

- Security boundaries: require approval for `test`/`[ -v` operands in exec allowlist mode, refuse browser proxy commands sent through generic node invoke, fail closed when sandboxed spawned children resolve CLI-backed models, carry `workspaceOnly` into Gateway-built delegate and media tools, keep unresolved Microsoft Teams allowlists restrictive, stop crafted Teams HTML from stalling the Gateway before sender checks, refuse embedded Control UI auth on pinned Android Gateway connections, and audit symlinked workspace skill roots. (#180880, #179880, #178742, #185094, #184989, #183438, #180843, #182384; related #111797) Thanks @eleqtrizit, @RomneyDa, @LeizhenZhang, and @dineshsuthar123.
- Security: keep browser pairing credentials out of opener process arguments, mask Google OAuth client secrets in logs, redact credentials from MCP CLI inspection, omit credentials from rejected search endpoint errors, and keep malformed piped input from corrupting model credentials. (#170289, #183193, #180321, #182534, #167251; related #180308) Thanks @eleqtrizit, @LeizhenZhang, @RomneyDa, @brandon-julio-t, @wr-web, and @Alix-007.
- Dependency security: update fast-uri, bound vendored Zod traversal for A2UI and Discord input, scope the patched MSAL for Microsoft Teams, and pick up nodemailer sender-parsing fixes for IMAP. (#187285, #187304, #187297, #187293, #187301) Thanks @RomneyDa and @shakkernerd.
- Terminal output: escape terminal control sequences in camera, channel capability and catalog, DNS setup, managed worktree, plugin uninstall, skills library, completion install, Gateway discovery, MCP registry, model auth profile, backup schedule, readable secret, session store, storage location, and message CLI output, and keep emoji and astral characters whole at diagnostic and metadata caps. (#175624, #178234, #178238, #181585, #181582, #183708, #178313, #184120, #183355, #181587, #181584, #184153, #184141, #184139, #183359, #176266, #183360, #176230, #176207, #181741, #181742, #182753, #183942, #183932) Thanks @SunnyShu0925, @obviyus, @RomneyDa, @Alix-007, @wangmiao0668000666, and @hugenshen.
- Replies: streaming a reply that mentions tool calls, contains tool-call XML, or ends long HTML at a partial tag no longer stalls the Gateway, missing-answer notices no longer follow streamed delivery, side-question replies no longer disappear or repeat after tool sends, multiline /btw, /loop, and /acp steer input is preserved, and compaction failures show instead of stale overflow advice. (#172631, #181397, #183252, #180765, #173798, #174869, #176293, #185456, #173310; related #175156, #180720, #176250, #185455) Thanks @JasonBuildAI, @RomneyDa, @LeizhenZhang, @goutamadwant, @yetval, @masatohoshino, and @TurboTheTurtle.
- Reply text: prevent MiniMax tool argument tails, deduplicate CRLF assistant replies, suppress rich payloads during silent turns, keep inline backticks from swallowing following prose when chunking, keep group-chat commands' line breaks and indentation, and stop TTS from duplicating captioned final text. (#183413, #183023, #129244, #180588, #183606, #181161; related #181070) Thanks @gdpu11, @RomneyDa, @AmelioMansour, @L4XB, @mushuiyu886, and @julianloperar.
- Sessions: preserve transcript IDs across idle resets and the linked model account across /new, /reset, and idle or daily resets, commit automation results during active turns, keep cleared history out of forks, keep a project folder without a worktree attached on reset, drain archive retention across pages, log unreadable transcript probes, and keep corrupt session rows from breaking session listings. (#184157, #179433, #181506, #166660, #182491, #181746, #182118, #181247; related #179432, #182474, #181722, #173080, #181092) Thanks @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @Shenrui-Ma, @ericcurtin, @resinoftree97, @xiaopan-xydt, @tre1d, @Yolo521-bot, @Patrick-Erichsen, and @davidcittadini.
- Session commands and lookups: report session read failures before native execution, fail cleanly when the runtime changes during turn preparation, omit directories from session file activity, match canonical Unicode titles, return canonical JSON for rejected compaction, store PostgreSQL pruned watermarks correctly, match agent bind and unbind routes case-insensitively, and make /session unbind report when nothing was removed and handle IDs containing U+241F. (#175654, #185573, #167732, #184374, #184131, #184911, #184717, #184857, #184317; related #184864) Thanks @enki, @RomneyDa, @GoldArowana, @Leon-SK668, @etzelm, and @A-Raphie.
- Sessions and follow-ups: preserve queued follow-ups after stopping preparation or a missed completion and drain them outside the plugin runtime generation, keep yielded-parent Stop alive while settling, reset a Main session archived by restart recovery, keep confirmed subagent cancellations final, and keep replies flowing after a restart with paused child tasks. (#172685, #159715, #181096, #176603, #176675, #176206, #175278, #185999; related #172658, #169077) Thanks @shakkernerd, @mbelinky, @RomneyDa, @hannnnn-l, @enki, and @VACInc.
- Subagents: prevent Gateway crashes during continuation conflicts, preserve restart recovery for delegated child work, keep unfinished restored cohorts out of the requester queue, settle consumed yield cohorts without retry, settle parent turns after an inline child reply, retain child results while a parent awaits Resume, avoid re-killing finished runs on session reset, leave interrupted delivery reservations to their recovery owner, preserve Claude parent replies after discarded subagent output, keep post-compaction continuation prompts, and keep queued collector runs out of operator completion custody. (#185386, #181373, #184022, #181260, #181933, #182587, #179731, #184100, #184352, #136236; related #178413, #143334) Thanks @RomneyDa, @SC-10749, @sukhdeepjohar, @Patrick-Erichsen, @BorClaw, @jalehman, @hidaba, @obviyus, @jaxonparrott, @vincentkoc, and @shakkernerd.
- Gateway restarts: keep restart custody when the request entry closes, preserve unfinished replies and subagent work across restarts, surface stale Gateway cleanup failures, clear the restart-loop breaker after an unlinked channel recovers, let first native turns await pending worker setup, confirm Windows Gateway shutdown after a slow connection refusal, honor a stop that arrives during an in-place restart, and restore the Gateway when Doctor receives SIGHUP. (#172852, #172412, #169144, #174590, #176182, #174807, #177184, #186055, #182901; related #174504, #174563) Thanks @RomneyDa, @shoaibulhaque, @altaywtf, @Yolo521-bot, @ericcurtin, @sunlit-deng, @prizmizm, and @freeqaz.
- Gateway: recover a channel account after a manual stop times out, reclaim obsolete native captures after startup, serve `GET /v1/models/{id}` for alias IDs that chat accepts, skip install discovery at startup when update checks are off, avoid catalog waits for empty agent rosters, and reject malformed usage cost scopes. (#177444, #176851, #180057, #181983, #182159, #158696; related #158099) Thanks @YangManBOBO, @RomneyDa, @harjothkhara, @yetval, @ruel225, @jonathanlindsay, @vincentkoc, and @Alix-007.
- Codex: keep plugin turns working under managed on-request approval policies, stop failing successful one-shot commands at cleanup, keep the next turn from stalling after Stop during a session handoff, release completed subagents after cleanup failures, recover queued chats and preserve startup failures, keep native child inference working after startup, stop asking for approval after setup consent, and keep the macOS Codex catalog available with valid plugin options. (#172592, #172639, #173516, #173580, #173547, #182104, #176311, #185920; related #161576) Thanks @RomneyDa, @stevenlee-oai, @Compassboot, @LLagoon3, @Kimiyu-186, @jjjhenriksen, @enki, and @obviyus.
- Codex native runtime: preserve the native catalog, completion continuity, protected scheduled continuations, and the prompt cache when reasoning effort changes, queue inference roots at capacity instead of failing turns, stop model fallback while native threads are active, and accept managed loopback proxy defaults. (#174900, #181528, #182397, #181895, #181204, #183232; related #181046, #180719) Thanks @enki, @Stronggenetics, @quqi1599, @Ricardodpalmeida, @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @jason-allen-oneal, @indra622, and @ermaxinc.

releases.body:
## 2026.10.9

### Highlights

- Patch vulnerable runtime dependencies: fast-uri 4.2.3 rejects malformed URI schemes and hosts in MCP schema validation, oversized Zod collections are rejected early in A2UI and the Discord embedded app SDK, IMAP sender parsing uses nodemailer 10.1.4 so spoofed senders cannot pass the sender token gate, and Microsoft Teams uses patched MSAL Node 7.1.1. (#187294) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Apply `tools.fs.workspaceOnly` to Gateway-built tools, so delegate changes still require approval and media tools stay inside the workspace. (#185094) Thanks @eleqtrizit, @RomneyDa, and @shakkernerd.
- Keep live credentials out of MCP CLI inspection and mask Google OAuth client secrets in logs. (#180321, #180308, #183193) Thanks @brandon-julio-t, @wr-web, @LeizhenZhang, and @RomneyDa.
- Make failed update rollbacks safe: Git-source rollbacks preserve operator edits instead of resetting the checkout, and npm rollbacks retry transient Windows denials and report the exact move that restores a bootable install instead of stranding the package root. (#185201, #184887, #185160, #184889) Thanks @wr-web, @syxscott, @LiuwqGit, @shakkernerd, and @RomneyDa.
- Recover intact agent databases and stale full-text indexes after SQLite tokenizer changes, including update snapshots. (#176234, #176220, #176833, #181206) Thanks @ndakota79 and @RomneyDa.
- Repair publication-complete updates after a remount while retaining the original launcher and sealed recovery helper. (#186557, #186527) Thanks @ericcaiwx-star, @sennyhoney, and @RomneyDa.
- Migrate large transcript archives without exceeding Node.js string limits. (#170853, #170847) Thanks @iamonlv426 and @RomneyDa.
- Allow agents to recover after a full disk once space becomes available, without requiring a restart. (#176902) Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Changes

This maintenance release focuses on security dependency patches, recovery, data preservation, and reliability fixes.

### Fixes

- Resolve local media in Codex steering messages from the session's own workspace instead of the agent's default workspace. (#181528) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Report uncertain process cleanup from buffered commands, such as local CLI speech providers, instead of presenting it as an ordinary command failure. (#184270, #184237) Thanks @shakkernerd and @RomneyDa.
- Keep reapproved node connections alive by publishing the approval with its committed pairing facts before the request resumes. Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Recover stopped Gateways when service activation cannot be verified; retain untouched-recovery behavior in Windows triage. (#172784, #181577, #181698) Thanks @SMF12138 and @RomneyDa.
- Avoid uninstalling a Gateway service during a passive macOS stop when no service is installed. (#181257) Thanks @shakkernerd, @LiuwqGit, @eleqtrizit, @syxscott, and @RomneyDa.
- Recover CLI Node runtimes when launched from the filesystem root, including launchd jobs. (#178112, #177739) Thanks @downingkeys and @RomneyDa.
- Start new ACP sessions in the requested working directory instead of the default workspace. (#176852, #123557) Thanks @yinx65588-boop, @crappier, and @RomneyDa.
- Prevent overlapping model refreshes from failing requests. (#179144) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Honor an explicit SSH port 22 in `openclaw gateway probe --ssh` instead of the alias's configured port. (#171092) Thanks @zhangguiping-xydt, @obviyus, and @RomneyDa.
- Keep skill metadata such as icons and homepages when an inline YAML metadata value has a trailing comment. (#171224) Thanks @zhangguiping-xydt, @Takhoffman, and @RomneyDa.
- Show provider-ignored options in `openclaw infer video generate` text and JSON output. (#171172) Thanks @ly85206559, @obviyus, and @RomneyDa.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.10.8..c213740c8338a05ac1a6db036e0d11060e70bf5d history: 48 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 48 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

releases.name: openclaw 2026.9.36
releases.body:
This is a gateway-only `extended-stable` release, which is our current equivalent to LTS. This release is OpenClaw from the end of September 2026, plus critical security updates, reliability and performance fixes, and features like new model support. The latest version of OpenClaw at the time of this release is [2026.10.9](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/releases#release-v2026.10.9)

## 2026.9.36

### Highlights

- **Failed updates stay recoverable:** a failed npm rollback no longer leaves the installed package missing, and update checks keep Doctor recovery guidance, stop recopying private rehearsal databases, and no longer reopen candidate-migrated state. Fixes #184889. (#185160, #186177) Thanks @syxscott, @LiuwqGit, and @RomneyDa.
- **Workspace restrictions reach Gateway-built tools:** with `tools.fs.workspaceOnly`, `openclaw` delegates built through Gateway loopback and skill dispatch now require approval as intended, and media tools stay inside the workspace. (#185094) Thanks @eleqtrizit and @RomneyDa.
- **Microsoft Teams allowlists stay restrictive:** name-keyed `teams` or `groupAllowFrom` entries that do not resolve now grant nothing instead of opening the bot to every team or group. (#184989) Thanks @eleqtrizit, @RomneyDa, and @shakkernerd.
- **Untrusted input is bounded:** malformed media metadata, inbound mail addresses, TOML, URIs, oversized collections in custom A2UI schemas and Discord's embedded SDK, and response-controlled Microsoft authentication routing can no longer cause unbounded work or alter identity. (#187288, #187282, #187283, #187305, #187289, #187287) Thanks @RomneyDa and @cyyynthia.
- **Replies keep their text:** comparison prose after emoji and other astral characters is no longer stripped from outbound replies. (#187415) Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Changes

- **Certificate trust and Docker images:** the eMudhra trust remediation is applied, and Docker release images carry source/version-bound evidence with more reliable architecture builds. (#186639) Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Fixes

- **Credential and content boundaries:** derive the filesystem policy for Gateway-built OpenClaw tools, keep unresolved Microsoft Teams allowlists closed, and scope the patched MSAL to the affected Teams and Azure Identity consumers. ## 2026.10.10-beta.4

### Highlights

### Changes

### Fixes

- Automations: preserve authenticated operator authority for explicit same-conversation scheduled follow-ups, including one-shot `next_check` rearming, while retaining role, session, cancellation, target, and tool-policy revocation boundaries. (#176422) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Gateway security: keep an environment-referenced `hooks.token` out of agent host-exec and CLI child environments at startup and across config reloads, while preserving explicit per-command overrides. (#179199) Thanks @VACInc and @RomneyDa.
- Memory Wiki: preserve human-authored Notes when OKF concept pages are re-imported or removed from the producer bundle, including changed producer content and legacy pages without a marked Notes slot. (#175707, #179657; related #175700) Thanks @YangManBOBO and @RomneyDa.
- Claude CLI: keep the native Claude session and its context when subagent completions or channel turns run in a Control UI-started session, instead of reseeding from saved history each time. (#178955; fixes #178953) Thanks @Marvinthebored and @RomneyDa.
- Model catalogs: honor a configured primary account pin when deciding model readiness, so native Claude CLI models no longer appear as missing auth when the selected token profile is ready. (#178522; related #178502) Thanks @ericcaiwx-star, @RomneyDa, and @eduardonunesfreire-rgb.
- Backup and restore: preserve supported legacy exec-approval allowlists when sanitizing snapshots instead of replacing them with deny-all; malformed policies remain fail-closed. (#164297) Thanks @wangmiao0668000666, @RomneyDa, @shanselman, @dor-sr, @cristianoc, and @brucemccurdy.
- Linux companion: persist each saved Gateway dashboard's private browser identity across restarts, while removing storage for deleted Gateways so re-added endpoints pair as fresh devices. (#158908) Thanks @dor-sr, @RomneyDa, @shanselman, @wangmiao0668000666, and @brucemccurdy.
- Agent database lifecycle: keep peer readers and borrowers alive when maintenance or PostgreSQL opening is refused, preserve the original refusal and clean-restart seal, and retain pre-dispatch recovery behavior when a worker generation disappears. (#175987, #163258, #179320) Thanks @RomneyDa, @shanselman, @dor-sr, @wangmiao0668000666, @brucemccurdy, @goutamadwant, and @hawkit.
- macOS bundled Gateway: show the actual installed Gateway version, keep failed or incomplete recovery actionable, and prevent stale or pending update receipts from blocking a valid repair. (#181389) Thanks @shanselman, @RomneyDa, @dor-sr, @wangmiao0668000666, and @brucemccurdy.
- Model refresh: let explicit catalog refreshes use their existing extended discovery budget through HTTP acquisition while ordinary preparation remains bounded. (#177313) Thanks @jlapenna and @RomneyDa.
- Webhooks and scheduled scripts: classify trusted immediate producers as events, retain each webhook's own automation scope, and refresh disposed script hooks before execution without replaying completed effects. (#172775, #177825, #178904) Thanks @RomneyDa, @jlapenna, and @jalehman.
- Runtime security: backport patched embedded runtimes to the 2026.10.10 line. (#181074) Thanks @RomneyDa and @joshavant.
- Update finalization: keep a verified healthy target successful when a recognized late restart-health or legacy-wrapper maintenance step fails, while authority, data-at-risk, deferred-admission, and unknown failures remain fatal. (#181166; fixes #181020) Thanks @najef1979-code.
- Package update recovery: automatically settle verified interrupted publications or retire untouched preparations, preserve the installed candidate and original Gateway recovery evidence, and keep live update ownership and restart authority fenced. (#181307; fixes #181235) Thanks @agroman1993.
- CLI config writes and setup with a running Gateway: `openclaw config set`, `config unset`, and `openclaw setup` now send their change through the running Gateway as one `config.patch` instead of refusing, with the same result as an offline write, no restart while reload is off, and a success acknowledgement when the Gateway accepts a restart, so Windows companion setup completes again. (#182951, #184194, #184392, #184532, #185109) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Codex native subagents: unblock parent replies after native children finish, are interrupted, or complete follow-ups; stop resurrecting undeliverable child completions; replay completed grandchildren correctly after Gateway restarts; keep native tool declarations across completion turns; and let Stop succeed after parent thread reuse. (#173018, #175246, #177577, #179050, #179099, #183286, #181475; fixes #178395) Thanks @quqi1599, @Stronggenetics, @linancn, @mmartoccia, @wtfichigo, @Marvinthebored, and @RomneyDa.
- Claude CLI: stop prompt-cache prefix churn after a child completion. (#172026) Thanks @Marvinthebored and @VACInc.
- Scheduled runs: wait for tool results before answering, so cron run summaries report the real result instead of a premature "no results" reply. (#179690) Thanks @obviyus.
- Agent restart recovery: release restart-recovery fences for killed runs so their conversations no longer stay blocked. (#181992; fixes #181952) Thanks @najef1979-code.
- Windows exec: restore command execution for Gateways running as an S4U scheduled task when Store PowerShell is installed. (#182898; fixes #182652) Thanks @RomneyDa and @tre1d.
- Kimi: give Kimi K3.1 Pro the K3 thinking and video controls. (#181923) Thanks @obviyus.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.10.10-beta.3..ed2b311521579d51523c9e31f1c326310e2c2922 history: 60 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 60 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

releases.body:
## 2026.10.8

### Highlights

- **Updates that finish and recover:** an ordinary post-update Doctor failure restarts the Gateway instead of leaving it stopped, an orphaned maintenance worker no longer blocks every CLI command and Gateway start, and updates no longer abort on ACL filesystems, Windows pnpm optional-dependency links, pnpm 10 global installs, debug console logging, or a missing legacy OAuth directory. (#180668, #181695, #181141, #181596, #181456, #182850, #180174) Thanks @hannesrudolph, @SMF12138, @rayluo88, @PonySlayer28, and @VN77-77VN.
- **Gateway service installs on every desktop:** macOS recovers a loaded launchd registration whose plist was deleted, Linux installs under the Ubuntu default umask create a private state directory instead of being refused, and the macOS updater waits for the serving Gateway to release its databases before Doctor runs. (#180390, #179538, #182055) Thanks @avnishkirnalli and @XiaoPengYouCode.
- **Conversations keep accepting messages:** killed runs release their restart-recovery fence, interrupted and just-accepted child sessions recover after a Gateway restart, inbound messages stop retrying forever when the reply runtime cannot publish, and the Control UI forgotten-send retry delivers the reply instead of an authoring error. (#181992, #178888, #181871, #181300, #182219) Thanks @najef1979-code, @handcraftrc-pixel, @sukhdeepjohar, and @teddashh.
- **Startup and database resilience:** startup work no longer inherits a closed SQLite reader scope, so models, chat metadata and channel replies stay available; transient lock contention during agent database startup is retried; and model catalogs stay available during skill runs. (#182615, #182446, #182385)
- **Security hardening:** exec allowlist mode requires approval for `test -v` operand expansion, generic node invoke refuses browser proxy commands, sandboxed spawned children cannot run host CLI backends, the secret egress proxy rejects distrusted eMudhra chains, Fish Audio and Gradium errors no longer expose API keys, and deeply nested Tlon content can no longer stall the channel. (#180880, #179880, #178742, #179249, #178877, #177536) Thanks @eleqtrizit and @joshavant.
- **Windows exec and plugins:** agent exec works under S4U scheduled tasks while Store PowerShell is installed, native plugins load on machines with Endpoint DLP, and Doctor recovers dangling dependency junctions and plugins on another filesystem. (#182898, #179949, #179549, #179445) Fixes #182652 Thanks @RomneyDa, @tre1d, @coaiMax, @paulcam206, @JIRBOY, and @ceckert.
- **Provider and model continuity:** Codex turns keep their budget with older runtime plugins instead of silently falling back, Codex native child inference works after startup, OpenAI OAuth works with stale catalogs, Anthropic PDF analysis works with setup-token OAuth, a timed-out MCP session close no longer fails the next turn, and CLI history owner changes stop instead of silently replaying on another provider. (#182995, #176311, #181356, #178420, #182189, #180075) Fixes #181619 Thanks @RomneyDa, @kip-claw, @enki, @sasan1200, @sunlit-deng, @khensthoth, @aniketkrs, @goslingmanagment, @wr-web, and @teddashh.

### Changes

- **Fresh OpenAI setup:** first-run model metadata no longer restricts the model picker to one model. (#175945) Thanks @matthematics1137 and @jb-dev1.

### Fixes

- **Channel accounts:** default Slack, Google Chat, X, Nextcloud Talk and Zalo accounts keep starting and keep their secrets after a named account is added. (#176267, #180450, #182608) Thanks @555aaditya, @progerjkd, and @masatohoshino.
- **Slack:** an isolated `invalid_auth` is retried before a socket-mode channel is disabled, and silent relay network drops reconnect. (#181056, #182368) Thanks @mushuiyu886 and @marns.
- **Matrix, Twitch, Zalo, iMessage and Feishu delivery:** ordinary Matrix messages are no longer treated as text commands, Twitch sends normalize channel targets, Zalo DMs with URLs are handled, iMessage recovers after the Messages bridge dies, and Feishu quick-action cards send again. (#179506, #178480, #178938, #180900, #79832) Thanks @xiaopan-xydt, @doomy, @HeZ2z, @Takhoffman, @zzrs-xxxr, @namchamvinhcuu, and @xiabee.
- **Agent runs and providers:** heartbeat loops stop when background commands finish, temporary Codex probe workers no longer accumulate, Codex native turns stay alive during host work, Claude CLI turns no longer stall 15 minutes when stream output hits its limit, provider stream errors surface immediately, and session admission races no longer trigger model fallback. (#179060, #167390, #181839, #159931, #117397, #179347) Fixes #178937, #181805, and #178000 Thanks @maxdjohnson, @sunlit-deng, @Terwox, @AINCHORS, @robertmsale, and @davidcittadini.
- **Voice and meetings:** Discord realtime voice consults initialize their runtime, voice calls use the configured agent model, and long meeting talk-back replies keep their audio. (#179462, #181451, #178254) Thanks @shoaibulhaque, @yagizkus, @potoior, @BeyonceBot, and @sukhdeepjohar.
- **Remote access and history:** Tailscale Serve and Funnel recover after tailscaled restarts, and cron history stays readable after provider changes. (#180081, #181311) Thanks @enki, @saariuslystoned, and @xtimor.
- **Doctor repairs:** retained transcripts verify after heading repairs, and repair keeps the Codex host compaction model. (#179089, #179914) Thanks @mrsavingsblogspot-rgb and @LiuwqGit.
- **Plugins and nodes:** older plugin debounce callbacks keep working, computer use accepts input results from older Mac nodes, and Memory Wiki keeps user Notes when OKF concepts disappear. (#118011, #137755, #179657)
- **Secrets and hooks:** the 1Password secret provider accepts group-writable OpenClaw files, and concurrent session-memory captures no longer overwrite each other. (#181127, #181081) Thanks @jalehman, @jason-allen-oneal, and @yetval.
- **Doctor recovery messages:** when Doctor cannot restore a Gateway it stopped, it prints the failure and how to start the Gateway. (#181941)
- **Codex native children and replies:** completed or undeliverable child completions no longer replay or wedge parents, replies unblock after native children finish, are interrupted, or complete follow-ups, final answers survive transient retries, settled turns without a mirrored prompt finalize, native tool declarations stay stable, queued chats recover after plugin reloads, submitted steering commits before terminal release, and Codex accepts managed loopback proxy defaults. (#173018, #175246, #177577, #179099, #179050, #183286, #181779, #183077, #182104, #184062, #183232) Thanks @quqi1599, @Stronggenetics, @linancn, @wtfichigo, @mmartoccia, @Marvinthebored, @sukhdeepjohar, @jjjhenriksen, @aatreya, @ermaxinc, and @RomneyDa.

(#170322, #182267, #181966, #182273, #183765, #183059, #179203) Thanks @cassthebandit, @VACInc, @goslingmanagment, @holgergruenhagen, @xiaopan-xydt, @Marvinthebored, @scarabone, @atomsmasher81, @josh-cornelius, and @teddashh.
- **Subagents and agent turns:** model fallback stops after local runtime faults, recovered child results deliver after session reuse, private completion receipts reconcile after a restart, parents keep waiting for active collectors, batched tool calls settle before `sessions_yield`, delayed `sessions_send` replies are no longer cut at 4,096 characters, turns finish after tool-result recovery, messages sent during transcript rebuilds are recovered, and completed attempt callbacks are released. (#180042, #184069, #184041, #172959, #184021, #178271, #175685, #182666, #164843, #183884) Thanks @sunlit-deng, @danielsiemers, @johan-eilertsen, @jailbirt, @rjdotdev, @wr-web, @seriouslysean, @MSNexploder, and @PollyBot13.
- **Gateway stability and streaming:** long HTML and JSX answers, crafted Teams HTML, and replies that look like tool calls no longer stall the Gateway; reasoning tags are withheld before streaming; silent turns no longer send rich payloads; channel restarts survive exited-run cancellation; the Gateway closes after forced plugin retirement; plugin service schedules outlive the scope that created them; and cold tool inventories no longer grow memory. (#175472, #183438, #183252, #182454, #129244, #182433, #181270, #182207, #178596) Thanks @JasonBuildAI, @LeizhenZhang, @zax0rz, @JOY, @0xtc23, @bguliano, @obviyus, and @wuqxuan.
- **Updates, installs and Doctor:** Windows managed updates no longer lock themselves on TEMP aliases, the Windows installer runs through `iex`, updates complete during channel outages and keep accepted policy pins, stopped database backups allow readers, Doctor restores the Gateway after SIGHUP, keeps valid reseeded configs and inherited logins, repairs unsupported Node runtimes, recovers agents after deletion journal loss, restores plugin host links, handles very large retained histories, and uses less memory on large fleets. (#183622, #183145, #179471, #180505, #180827, #182901, #183703, #179726, #181618, #181804, #181140, #180414, #180792, #181465) Thanks @ryandle, @duyufansh2008, @waynegault, @csabatatrai, @samueltardieu, @4140leal-cw, @rybing7, @RomneyDa, @LiuwqGit, @sukhdeepjohar, and @teddashh.
- **Sessions and storage:** relative session stores resolve against the state directory, sessions archive through symlinked state paths, stale restart-recovery sources no longer wedge sessions, cron cleanup keeps live child sessions, archived Discord slash-command sessions restore in place, background plugin work keeps its SQLite reader, and session deletes reuse warm archive workers. (#182444, #181554, #180853, #179057, #168596, #179031, #171156, #175091, #183410) Thanks @erickj92, @Cloud-Ocean, @Oldrich333, and @PollyBot13.
- **Auth and providers:** rate-limited profiles cool down only as long as the provider asks, shared OAuth refreshes past deleted peers, concurrent agents keep MCP tool access while an OAuth credential is leased, utility models no longer return thinking-only replies, custom GLM providers generate session titles, Kimi K3.1 Pro gets the K3 thinking and video controls, Bedrock Mantle GPT models route through Responses, Google streams recover, and native conversations survive a compaction fallback model. (#180280, #179205, #179997, #169920, #172580, #181923, #182437, #117194, #183282) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev, @WG-Mojo, @maliv2, @danielsiemers, @jacobtomlinson, @TommyLei666, @obviyus, @rayvader, and @pstarkgit.
- **Channels:** Telegram and Mattermost default accounts keep their tokens after a named account is added, X accounts with capitalized keys can be managed and synced, iMessage stops answering its own self-chat replies, Feishu keeps streamed text across tool calls, Google Chat delivers remote attachments as links, Synology Chat stops reporting false delivery failures, Tlon recovers after network drops, and channel images a turn could not read are retried.
